obs_date_semantics.lookahead_mitigation: 1-day publication lag means obs_date=D revisions are not consumable until D+1 10:00 UTC; same-clock look-ahead within the EEH feed is structurally unlikely
obs_date_semantics.amc_same_day_inference: For AMC releases (~21:00 UTC), a same-calendar-day obs_date revision was contributed during day D and published next UTC morning — likely predates the announcement; relaxed join more defensible for AMC than artifact v2 credited

same_day_attrition_risk.summary: Strict obs_date < act_rpt_date rejects all same-calendar-day collisions; likely over-conservative for AMC given D+1 EEH delivery
same_day_attrition_risk.likely_concentration: BTO/DTM events where morning announce may precede same-day revision receipt
same_day_attrition_risk.verifier_authority: PEAD contract allows project-defined join convention once documented in pinned manifest
